name: Kicker
notes: Companion Intelligence's texting assistant that picks your three priorities for the day, blocks time, syncs Oura, WHOOP, Fitbit and calendars, and shops through a paired Chrome so checkout runs in your own logged-in accounts. Added after hands-on testing over iMessage.
tagline: Your AI friend that actually knows what's going on in your life

access.price: $14.99/mo, $9.99/mo billed yearly, or $3.99/wk; 7-day free trial, no card
